# Astronomy Engine

- Version: 2.1.19 (JavaScript browser UMD build).
- Author: Don Cross.
- License: MIT, retained in the file header.
- Upstream commit: `865d3da7d8112bbc7911238052c6af4aaf877181`.
- Original: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cosinekitty/astronomy/865d3da7d8112bbc7911238052c6af4aaf877181/source/js/astronomy.browser.min.js
- Documentation: https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy/blob/865d3da7d8112bbc7911238052c6af4aaf877181/source/js/README.md
- Downloaded: 2026-10-02. File is unmodified.

Used locally in the visitor's browser for oppositions, maximum elongations,
global solar/lunar eclipse peaks and lunar distances. No extra service request
or credentials are required. Event descriptions are original Gregle copy.
The eclipse type for solar events describes the greatest-eclipse point, not
every point along the path. Event times are planning calculations, not local
eclipse contact times.
